---
title: Does the NCF have any binding rules for the members?
date: 2025-01-01 00:00 UTC
order: 7
---

Yes, theNCF has a constitution and an ethical framework.

### Memorandum of Association

We adopted a [memorandum](/files/thencf-memo.pdf) at our first official meeting in 2023 that sets out the foundational constitution of the co-op.

### Code of Ethics

We also adopted a [code of ethics](/files/ncf-ethics.pdf) that expands on the original memo and applies to all our members and their activities.
